instruction: Given `/home/user/Desktop/fab_capability.md` - a plain-text summary of a fab's 6-layer HDI process capabilities - author `/home/user/Desktop/hdi_6layer.dru`, a static EAGLE design-rules file (INI-style key=value) encoding every applicable rule. The capability thresholds your `.dru` must satisfy: 1. The file parses as key=value (at least 10 entries). 2. Every pair-clearance key (mdWireWire, mdWirePad, mdWireVia, mdPadPad, mdPadVia, mdViaVia, mdSmdPad, mdSmdVia, mdSmdSmd) <= 0.1 mm. 3. MsWidth (minimum trace width) <= 0.09 mm. 4. MdDrill (minimum drill hole diameter) <= 0.15 mm. 5. MsMicroVia (microvia drill minimum) <= 0.1 mm. 6. LayerSetup string references layers 1..6 (e.g. `(1+(2+(3*4)+5)+6)` or any other 6-layer form). 7. MtCopper first six entries each <= 0.018 mm (0.5 oz copper). Values may use any of the units `mm`, `mil`, `um`, `inch` (e.g. `3.9mil` equals 0.0991 mm). Values are compared after unit normalisation. [Software] On Linux, launch CadSoft EAGLE with `/opt/eagle-7.7.0/bin/eagle` (adjust to your install).
